title: b7z9.37(b): C root-sig DIO option parse + CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_SIG Kconfig
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37 (spec/06-security.md:587-700). Add root-signature DIO option parsing to the C rpl option table and the CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_SIG Kconfig gating root signature inclusion (root SHOULD include when y, L694); receiver validation mirrors python/src/lichen/crypto/root_dio_signature.py verify_root_dio_signature:278-362 against test/vectors/root_dio_signature.json. Nodes MUST NOT reject DIOs solely for missing capability (L679). Host-buildable CMake test per lichen/tests patterns.
